leo: During close QA I found a mis-allocation of a bundle discount that pushed $64,200 of ARR into the wrong subscription's deferred schedule. Pulled from `close_reports/2027-08-bundle-alloc.csv`.

hana: Which bundle and customers?

leo: Bundle=Enterprise-PartnerPack discount_id=BD-7721. Applied across customers CUST-210, CUST-211, and CUST-212. The billing runner allocated the discount 100% to CUST-211 due to a join key bug; should be split pro-rata by MRR.

priya: SQL I ran: `select customer_id, allocated_amount from bundle_alloc where bundle_id='BD-7721'` shows CUST-211=64200, CUST-210=0, CUST-212=0. Expected splits: 30/50/20 -> 19,260 / 32,100 / 12,840.

acct-bot: Ticket FIN-9217 created: "bundle-discount-allocation-misalloc-BD-7721" assigned=leo.

hana: For close: we need to reverse the incorrect deferral for CUST-211 and re-allocate the deferred balances to CUST-210 and CUST-212 so revenue schedules match contract obligations. Draft JE: DR 2100 DeferredRevenue 64,200 / CR 4000 AR 64,200 to clear the single allocation, then DR 4000 AR 19,260 / CR 2100 DeferredRevenue 19,260; DR 4000 AR 32,100 / CR 2100 DeferredRevenue 32,100; DR 4000 AR 12,840 / CR 2100 DeferredRevenue 12,840 dated 2027-08-31.

priya: That mapping seems right but we should avoid moving AR amounts between customers without audit trail. Instead do: reverse the single allocation (JE- draft) and create new allocation entries that post to correct customer rev schedules and apply contra entries referencing bundle_id. Net effect is same but preserves customer ledgers.

revops: Approve approach. Ensure JE memos include bundle_id BD-7721 and ticket FIN-9217. Also add note that this is below the CFO manual JE threshold.

leo: I've prepared reversal JE draft JE-100211 and created allocation entries in staging for verification. Will attach CSVs.

acct-bot: FIN-9217 updated: status=in_review je=JE-100211 attachments=[reports/2027-08-bundle-alloc.csv, staging_alloc_verify.csv].

hana: After posting, run `python tools/rev_schedule_check.py --period 2027-08 --filter bundle_id=BD-7721` to confirm schedules equal expected splits. Also add a unit test to the allocation service covering join-key collisions.

priya: Posted JE-100211 in NetSuite (status=posted). Updated FIN-9217 -> resolved.

acct-bot: FIN-9217 updated: status=resolved resolution="reversed misalloc, reallocated pro-rata, JE-100211".

leo: Thanks everyone. Adding post-close action: add a gating rule to allocation job to assert total bundle allocation equals bundle discount total and to log per-customer splits before commit. Closing thread once rev_schedule_check passes.
